messages.body:
I am the only one struggling to run PMC checks on MacOS? Whenever I run a command such as `breeze release-management prepare-provider-distributions --include-removed-providers --distribution-format both --version-suffix ""`, my terminal quits with:

```
Malicious script detected

A script was blocked because it contains malware. This script did not harm your Mac.
```

messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] Airflow Providers, release preparation date 2026-10-06
messages.body:
Update on exclusions: in addition to dbt.cloud and google, I am also
excluding common.ai and amazon from this wave:

- common.ai 0.11.0rc1: SandboxToolset can no longer be deep-copied, so
  Dags that use it in default_args or a TaskGroup fail to parse.
  Fix: https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74525
- amazon 9.38.0rc1: my change broke AWS auth manager login with IAM
  Identity Center. Every login started from Airflow fails with 401.
  Fix: https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74529

All four (amazon, common.ai, dbt.cloud, google) will get rc2 in an
ad-hoc wave once the fixes are merged. The vote for the remaining
providers continues and ends 2026-10-11 14:47 UTC. Binding votes are
still very welcome :).

J.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
